source: The throwaway prototype `src/core/entitlement.prototype/` as of commit 29232ef (deleted in #71; `git show 29232ef` recovers it) — `fuzz.ts --seed 42 --n 300`, the `fifo` variant, independently verified 2026-08-25 against an exact-rational reimplementation and a per-unit brute-force oracle (0 mismatches over 4,500 fields). Turned into this file by quantizing each history to token units first and re-running that verified rule over the quantized inputs — see `quantizationDrift` below and the header of `entitlement.regression.spec.ts`.

quantizationDrift.note: Worst gap between the expectations below and the same rule run on the prototype's ORIGINAL unquantized floats, in token units — how far quantizing the inputs to the units the chain actually uses moved the verified answers. The price gap is half a want unit: NAV rounded to 6 decimals, which is the only NAV a chain ever reports.
